caption: The drawing depicts a single object composed of three main parts: a plier-shaped tool at the top, a twisted cylindrical shaft in the middle, and a rough, rectangular base at the bottom. The plier-like tool sits vertically and is the highest part of the object, with its handles pointing upward. Attached to the shaft just below the plier is a curved hook or arm that projects outward and loops slightly at its end. The cylindrical shaft connecting the plier to the base has a spiral or twisted pattern along its length. The base is a large, irregularly shaped, blocky mass with a textured, almost stone-like appearance. The drawing is in black and white, using fine, stippled and lined shading techniques to create texture and definition. The composition is centered on an off-white, plain background, and the artist's signature appears at the lower right corner.
title: Rush Holder
